reviews.title: Avoid a scam and sells your data
reviews.text:
Unfortunately we live in a world where we can't use the internet we pay for, the devices we have already paid for in peace. The best part is the predator you're trying to protect yourself from is the same predator making your VPN. This one is particularly demonic because they make you watch several LONG ads for the free version and slow down, disrupt and regulate your internet access forcing interaction with this hideous application. All this to make you subscribe. When you do, it's the exact same experience except you pay not to see ads. Everyone involved in this must go to jail!!

Update:
The developer has left a gaslighting message absolving themselves of the issues they have crested. The business model of a useless dweeb is create a problem: bots and hackers, and then offer a solution: this stupid app, VPN in general— so we can pay them to rob us. Truly disgusting. You could save the world, but you are sans souls. Please consider taking up concrete diving.
